chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: Winding down the name-checking session
summary: Willard and Spikes agree they have covered most names; a lamp topples over.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Do you feel like dealing with any more names, or would you like to quit now. We've been going a long time.
Yeah, I know. Well, that's about...ought to 'bout take care of it, oughtn't it?
I think so. Uhh, I think so. I think we've covered most of the people here.
Well, if there're any more names you want to call there, it's all right.
I just wondered if any of these people would be anybody that would remind you of...of anything that we can find out any more about them--other than just...

No, I just know all them fellows, and they all... [lamp topples over on adjacent desk, interrupting] They all worked with me, you know, and they worked with Paul Howard. They worked with anybody...uh.. uh, that had a job. You know.
